summary: Validator targets PLAN_ID toolchain-workflow-repair, self-hosted profile, slices W0-W6; requires listed contract, registry, authority, resume, architecture, delta, knowledge, tool, and skill artifacts (also reads plan-state.v1.json); validates TDD intent and required command IDs plan-ready, terminal-full, w0-w6 green/terminal; authority manifest must partition sources, candidates, lifecycle projections; draft cannot authorize, plan-ready requires valid VDD publication bound to plan-validation receipt; authorized-repair-revalidate requires implementation-authorized plan plus closed repair round-1 with no blocks/authorizations; resume, architecture acceptance, pre-existing delta commits 2556ea78... and a2ded39b..., exact delta paths/hashes/disposition, knowledge preflight and accepted modules are enforced; canonical skill-input receipt is mandatory, inside plan/skill-input, and must pass require-ready consumption validation; all outputs authorizes=[] and lifecycle_transition=none; writes validator input manifest and result when --out; exit 0 on pass, 1 on failures; modes select schema v1 or v4.
